answer: Each agent periodically posts a signed knoll‑indexed score on a shared ledger; the score is an echo of the previous block’s aggregated sonnet of grader reputations, and every new grader must attach a fresh zero‑knowledge proof that its vote correlates with at least 70 % of the historical consensus. The protocol cross‑checks these proofs across epochs, and any panel whose votes always co‑occur triggers a penalty.
